pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate patches with jagged, high-frequency edge crenellations. Patch edges exhibit moderately sharp pixel gradients against the lighter corridors. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank and reduces significantly in area toward the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a non-uniform lattice. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and tetra-radiate intersections. Corridor thickness is widest on the upper flank and narrows into thinner, more frequent lines toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, characterized by fine, hair-like vertical protrusions against the background.
